runtime/db#

The native layer under db/postgres, db/read, db/row, db/sqlite: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under db/postgres, db/read, db/row, db/sqlite: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.
